sections.heading: System identification
sections.body:
Name the system or systems this plan covers and give each a short identifier.
Say who owns the system and who runs it day to day.
Say what contract work or kind of information the system supports, in a sentence.

sections.heading: Operating environment
sections.body:
Describe where the systems run: offices, data centres, cloud services, remote workers.
List the main kinds of equipment and software, and the networks that join them.
Say how the environment is protected from the outside.

sections.heading: Where the information moves
sections.body:
Describe how controlled information enters, is stored, is processed and leaves the systems.
Name the services and people that handle it at each step.

sections.heading: Roles and responsibilities
sections.body:
List the roles that run and protect the systems and the people who hold them.
Say which duties belong to the organization, which to a service provider, and which are shared.

sections.heading: Connections to other systems
sections.body:
List each connection to a system outside the boundary: what it is, what passes over it, and how it is controlled.
Write 'none' if there are none.

sections.heading: Review and approval
sections.body:
Record who reviewed this plan, on what date, and what changed.
Say when it is next due for review.
